snippet.title: Scratch The Cat - Meet The Team Featurette
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/858200/Scratch_The_Cat/
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014813
Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/stratch-the-cat/9NH5L9PJ3HLZ 

As first seen as part of the Six One Indie Showcase, meet the team behind the game!
----
Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

- Expressive Movement - Scratch isn’t just any cat — he’s quick, nimble, and packed with style! Run, jump, slide, climb, swim, and dive through vibrant levels.

- Collect Record Fragments and Other Collectibles - The villain Snatch The Rat has shattered Scratch’s record collection and scattered the pieces across the world. It’s up to you to track them down.

- Face Off Against Unique Bosses - Snatch’s crew of goons and bosses are ready to challenge you! Each boss encounter blends platforming mastery with rhythm-inspired mechanics, keeping you on your toes.

- Explore a Musical World - Step into a world where music is life — literally! Discover lands infused with sound, where flora and fauna move to the beat, and technology hums with harmony.

- Customize Your Groove - Express yourself with a variety of customization options! Change Scratch’s look by unlocking unique outfits to personalize your journey.

- Signature “Scratch The Cat” Soundtrack - Vinyl scratching is mixed in with unconventional genres and instruments, creating a distinct “Scratch The Cat” sound.

Website: https://www.scratchthecatgame.com/
